notes: The description says: 'this is the same deck i just change the title(666 SATAN deck)'. No '666 SATAN deck' post is in the archive, so this is the surviving copy.

starting7 as posted: Hunt Down, Epic Duel, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Twi'lek Advisor, Crush The Rebellion, Visage Of The Emperor (counted in the 60; two Interrupts and two Effects start, so starting.interrupt/effect are left empty). Total 60 as published.

The location line 'hologameboard(mistake if it was in starting, it was suppose to be holotheater)' dested Executor: Holotheatre per the author's own note (no Hologameboard card exists), making 2 Holotheatres in all.

'vader stick x5' is listed under charater11 (the count needs 5 characters), so it is dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber (the Enhanced Premiere Vader), not the weapon; 'ig w stick' IG-88 With Riot Gun; the 'boat' lines the pilot-in-ship cards.
Visage Of The Emperor: 1 starting + 2 in interrupt/effect (3 in all); Twi'lek Advisor 1 + 3 (4 in all). Battle Order, Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward are the Endor/Special Edition Effects.
player_note: The post says: "this deck in tourney( not only in my region, in world 3 and 1 but without epp and ejp) is 16 and 1" – i.e. 3–1 at Worlds in a version without the Enhanced Premiere/Jabba's Palace cards, so this list may differ from what was played there.
